import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import savgol_filter, medfilt

def remove_spikes(x, y, window=5, threshold=5):
    y_med = medfilt(y, kernel_size=window)
    diff = np.abs(y - y_med)
    std = np.std(diff)
    mask = diff > threshold * std
    y_cleaned = np.copy(y)
    y_cleaned[mask] = y_med[mask]
    return y_cleaned, np.sum(mask)

def poly_baseline(x, y, order=5, iterations=10, threshold=0.05 * np.max(y)):
    y_curr = np.copy(y)
    for i in range(iterations):
        coeffs = np.polyfit(x, y_curr, order)
        p = np.poly1d(coeffs)
        baseline = p(x)
        mask = y >= baseline - threshold
        y_curr[mask] = baseline[mask]
        if i == iterations - 1:
            break
    return p(x)

# Load data
data = files[0]["table"]
x = data["raman_shift_cm-1"]
y = data["intensity"]

# 1. Spike Removal
y_despiked, spikes_removed = remove_spikes(x, y)

# 2. Baseline Correction (5th order poly)
baseline = poly_baseline(x, y_despiked, order=5)
y_bc = y_despiked - baseline

# 3. Savitzky-Golay Smoothing (window=11, order=3)
y_smooth = savgol_filter(y_bc, window_length=11, polyorder=3)

# 4. Normalization (0-1)
y_min = np.min(y_smooth)
y_max = np.max(y_smooth)
y_norm = (y_smooth - y_min) / (y_max - y_min)

# Verification and Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.subplot(2, 1, 1)
plt.plot(x, y, label='Original', alpha=0.5)
plt.plot(x, y_despiked, label='Despiked', color='red')
plt.title('Spike Removal')
plt.legend()

plt.subplot(2, 1, 2)
plt.plot(x, y_bc, label='Baseline Corrected', color='green')
plt.plot(x, y_norm * (np.max(y_bc)), label='Smoothed & Scaled back', color='blue')
plt.title('BC and Smoothing')
plt.legend()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Save result
save_result('T046_processed', y_norm, raman_shift=x)

print(f"Spikes removed: {spikes_removed}")
print(f"Normalization range: [{np.min(y_norm)}, {np.max(y_norm)}]")
print(f"Max intensity before norm: {np.max(y_smooth)}")

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import savgol_filter, medfilt

def remove_spikes(x, y, window=5, threshold=5):
    y_med = medfilt(y, kernel_size=window)
    diff = np.abs(y - y_med)
    std = np.std(diff)
    mask = diff > threshold * std
    y_cleaned = np.copy(y)
    y_cleaned[mask] = y_med[mask]
    return y_cleaned, np.sum(mask)

def poly_baseline(x, y, order=5, iterations=10):
    # Calculate threshold inside to avoid NameError
    thresh = 0.05 * np.max(y)
    y_curr = np.copy(y)
    for i in range(iterations):
        coeffs = np.polyfit(x, y_curr, order)
        p = np.poly1d(coeffs)
        baseline = p(x)
        mask = y >= baseline - thresh
        y_curr[mask] = baseline[mask]
    return np.poly1d(np.polyfit(x, y_curr, order))(x)

# Load data
